description: The Hover-1 Zyp’s standout feature is its effortless folding capability, allowing it to easily collapse into a more compact form. Ideal for urban living, the Zyp can be stored in tight spaces, taken on public transportation, or stowed in your car’s trunk for on-the-go exploration. It’s the perfect blend of convenience and practicality. But don't be fooled by its folding finesse, Zyp is a powerhouse on two wheels. Its sturdy frame supports up to 275 pounds of weight. The responsive 450W motor whisks you along at speeds of up to 20 mph, so you can conquer short commutes or enjoy leisurely rides. Cruise up to 21 miles on a single charge with the 36V/9.9Ah battery and a relaxed twist throttle grip. Designed for comfort, Zyp features a rear shock suspension, 16” air-filled tires, and a cushioned seat for a smooth and stable riding experience. The digital LCD display keeps you informed about your speed, battery life, distance traveled, and more. The LED headlight and taillight provide extra visibility, and the front and rear disc brakes offer reliable stopping power. Embrace the freedom of mobility, convenience, and performance with the Hover-1 Zyp.
